description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions related to age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point, log file selection, and handling missing gateway entry points, used within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: age strings cover common windows
methods.description: Tests age formatting for recent times and specific durations.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Verifies parsing of SSH target strings with user, host, and port information.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Checks that SSH prefix is correctly stripped and connection settings are properly read from defaults.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point returns the dist index.js path when both dist and bin exist.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Validates selection of the most recent log file based on modification date.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Confirms that the gateway entry point returns nil when no relevant files are found.
